blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Optical aberrations degrade fluorescence microscopy images and measuring the underlying point spread function (PSF) often requires dedicated acquisitions or isolated emitters. Here we introduce DeepBlur, a neural network that estimates spatially varying two-dimensional PSFs directly from single images of biological structures. Trained entirely on physical simulations spanning aberrations, illumination and noise, it adapts to diverse imaging conditions without requiring user-supplied optical parameters. Using a deformable mirror, we acquire 1,290 images and assess blind PSF estimates against independent references. DeepBlur estimates agree closely with these references and improve deconvolution of experimentally aberrated images. Local PSF estimation also enables correction of spatially varying defocus and improves random-illumination super-resolution reconstruction in biological tissue. Available through DeepInv, a napari plugin and a web demonstration, DeepBlur can be readily integrated into computational microscopy workflows.
blocks.zh: 光学偏差可降解荧光显微镜图像并测量所基于的点散函数(PSF)往往需要专门的获取或孤立的发射器. 在这里,我们引入了DeepBlur,一个神经网络,直接从生物结构的单个图像中,对空间变化的二维PSF进行估计. 它完全以物理模拟为主,跨越了异常、发光和噪音,适应不同的成像条件,而不需要用户提供的光学参数。 我们使用可变形的镜像,获得1,290个图像,并对照独立的参考文献评估盲目PSF估计. DeepBlur估计与这些参考文献非常一致,并改进了实验性反常图像的分解. 局部的PSF估计还能够校正空间相差分焦,并改进生物组织中的随机-发光超分辨率重建. 通过DeepInv,一款Capari插件和一款网络演示,DeepBlur可以随时被集成到计算显微镜工作流程中.

blocks.en: DeepBlur estimates local PSFs from single images
blocks.zh: DeepBlur 从单个图像估算本地 PSF

blocks.en:
The central output of DeepBlur is not a restored image but the optics response: a smoothly space-varying 2D PSF estimated directly from a
single aberrated image (Fig. 1 a).
A network reads the input through overlapping tiles and predicts, at each tile centre, the local PSF; assembling these local estimates yields a
space-varying blur operator, represented as a product-convolution expansion [ 10 ] .
The network combines a residual convolutional encoder, a multiscale context module and a head that predicts PSF pixel values directly
(Extended Data Fig. 1 ).
The optical parameters such as the numerical aperture or pixel size need not be specified.
A separate network estimates the noise parameters used for reconstruction; no calibration acquisition is required.

blocks.en:
An estimated PSF can be supplied to computational imaging methods that use an explicit blur model, including deconvolution and structured- or
speckle-illumination super-resolution. We exploit this throughout: for deblurring we pair the estimate with a fine-tuned Reconstruct
Anything Model (RAM) [ 41 ] , while for super-resolution we supply the estimated collection PSF to a random-illumination microscopy (RIM)
algorithm [ 26 ] .
The PSF estimator is thus a reusable module that provides an interpretable representation of the aberration. It can be inspected independently of the
restored image.

blocks.en:
The estimator is trained entirely on synthetic data (Fig. 1 b).
The clean training images come from a large pool of natural images drawn from diverse datasets, with random augmentations chosen to mimic
fluorescence-like structures. We then simulate aberrated images with a physics-based forward model of an incoherent microscope: a Zernike wavefront defines
a pupil function, and the squared magnitude of its Fourier transform gives the intensity PSF; this PSF is
applied to the illuminated image, which is then corrupted by a realistic Poisson–Gaussian noise model.
Aberrations, noise, illumination and cutoff frequency are drawn at random for every training example, exposing the network to a broad range of
imaging conditions.
Our aim is to cover a family of plausible optical conditions and image structures during training, so that variation within these simulated ranges is
learned directly rather than left to extrapolation from a narrow setting [ 14 ] .
Examples of simulated PSFs are shown in Extended Data Fig. 2 .
Full details are given in Online Methods.

blocks.en:
We first evaluated the method on synthetic data, where the ground-truth PSF is known exactly.
We assessed both PSF-estimation error and the gain in image quality after deconvolution with RAM.
Restoration yielded substantial improvements in image fidelity across the tested noise levels and aberration orders, with median PSNR gains of
6.4–8.3 dB over the blurred input (Fig. 1 c).
Including higher-order Zernike modes during training substantially improved PSF estimation for higher-order aberrations without compromising accuracy
for lower-order aberrations, supporting the use of a single model (Extended Data Fig. 3 ).

blocks.en: Experimental validation with a deformable mirror
blocks.zh: 用可变形镜进行实验验证

blocks.en:
To test whether estimates trained on simulated data transfer to real optical aberrations, we built an experimental benchmark using a deformable
mirror (Fig. 2 a).
The mirror was positioned in a plane conjugate to the objective pupil. At each field of view, we changed its shape to image the same sample region
under different optical aberrations.
We recorded 1,290 aberrated images using 42 different fields of view under 31 distinct mirror settings.
In addition, 42 flat-mirror images of the same fields were acquired to provide a reference.
Each aberrated image was paired with the flat-mirror image of its field for reference-PSF estimation.
The samples differed in emission wavelength and structure.
The database is available at https://zenodo.org/records/24304044 .

This reference exploits information that DeepBlur never accesses—a second, non-aberrated acquisition—so it serves as a stringent, informed benchmark
for the single-image blind estimate,
obtained through an entirely different route.
Reference PSFs for representative mirror states are shown in Extended Data Fig. 4 .

blocks.en:
Given only a single experimentally acquired aberrated image, DeepBlur recovered PSFs that closely matched the independent references
(Fig. 3 a). Across the 1,290 aberrated images, it achieved the best median values on all PSF measures (Fig. 3 b). The
importance of our training procedure is made clear using the JMKPD architecture [ 4 ] .
With its original pretrained weights, JMKPD performed poorly; retraining the same architecture with our simulation and training procedure nearly
halved its median error, making it the strongest competitor to DeepBlur.
This improvement with the architecture held fixed highlights the importance of training for transfer to real aberrations, while DeepBlur’s further
gain shows that architecture also matters. Our earlier synthetic-only estimator Db0 [ 7 ] was used as published;
L0 [ 30 ] and SelfDeblur [ 34 ] were optimized separately for each image without pretraining. All three yielded
substantially less accurate PSFs.

blocks.en:
We next evaluated how well a fine-tuned RAM model [ 41 ] restored the experimentally aberrated images using the estimated PSF
from each method. Keeping the reconstruction model fixed also provided an image-based assessment of the PSF estimates. DeepBlur’s
estimates achieved the best restoration on every image-quality metric (Fig. 3 b), surpassing the aberrated input and the
segmentation-oriented restoration model
Cellpose3 [ 37 ] , and approaching the quality obtained with the
reference PSF itself. Qualitatively, on the Argolight star target, fine radial structures lost to aberration
were restored when RAM was driven by DeepBlur’s PSF, yet remained blurred or
corrupted with the alternatives (Fig. 3 c).
Across the 1,290 aberrated images, RAM deconvolution with DeepBlur-estimated PSFs improved PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS in over 80%, 90%, and 98% of
cases, respectively, compared with the aberrated inputs (Extended Data Fig. 5 ).

blocks.en: DeepBlur estimates space-varying defocus
blocks.zh: DeepBlur 估计空间变化去聚焦

blocks.en:
DeepBlur estimates PSFs that vary across the field of view from a single image.
We tested this by deliberately tilting a prepared slide relative to the focal plane.
The slide contained a layer of bovine pulmonary artery endothelial cells (BPAECs) labelled with Texas Red-X phalloidin, which we imaged with an
NA 1.49 objective (Fig. 4 a).
Across the 78 ​ μ ​ m 78\,\mu\mathrm{m} field of view, defocus therefore varies linearly with lateral position, resulting in progressively broader PSFs on
either side of the in-focus line. Changing the axial focus position shifts the in-focus line across the field of view.

滑行中含有一层以德克萨斯红-X-phalloidin为标签的牛肺动脉内皮细胞(BPAECs),我们用一个图象描绘出这些细胞。

中焦点线的任意一面。 改变轴心焦点位置会使焦点线横跨视野.

blocks.en:
To estimate the true defocus, we located the best-focus plane of each region by keeping the sharpest patch in a nine-plane z z -stack (Methods).
We then applied DeepBlur patch by patch to each plane separately, yielding one PSF per region and plane.
Across the 1,089 resulting PSFs, each estimated from a single image, PSF width (diameter of the smallest circle enclosing 50% of the PSF
intensity) was strongly correlated with the absolute axial distance to best focus: PSFs were narrowest at best focus, close to the diffraction limit
( 277 ± 19 277\pm 19 nm, versus 238 nm for an ideal in-focus PSF), and broadened on both sides.
Within the defocus range covered at training time ( ± 287 \pm 287 nm), the widths were consistent with the reference defocus with less than 12% error
for half of the patches; beyond it, the defocus width estimated by DeepBlur kept increasing but stayed below reality with a median error of 22%.
Larger defocus values were deliberately excluded from training because the attenuation of high spatial frequencies makes PSF estimation increasingly
difficult. Nevertheless, the estimated PSF widths continued to increase with defocus beyond the training range, suggesting that the network
generalizes at least qualitatively to larger defocus values.

然后我们通过补丁将DeepBlur补丁分别应用到每个平面上,每个区域和平面产生一个PSF.

blocks.en: PSF estimation improves super-resolved reconstruction in random illumination microscopy
blocks.zh: PSF 估计在随机发光显微镜中改善超解重建

blocks.en:
We next tested whether PSFs estimated by DeepBlur could also improve super-resolution reconstruction by supplying them to AlgoRIM [ 26 ] ,
the reconstruction algorithm used in random illumination microscopy (RIM; Fig. 5 ).
RIM reconstructs a super-resolved image from a sequence of speckle-illuminated acquisitions using the illumination statistics and the collection
PSF. Its optical sectioning and robustness to excitation aberrations make it well suited to imaging within biological tissue,
but reconstruction quality still depends on an appropriate collection PSF. RIM therefore allows us to test whether local 2D PSF estimates improve
lateral reconstruction within thick specimens.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来测试了DeepBlur估计的PSF是否能够通过向AlgoRIM提供它们来改善超解析重建[26],
用于随机发光显微镜的重建算法(RIM;图5)。
RIM 重建一个超解的图像 从一个序列的光谱-发光获取 使用照明统计和收集
PSF (英语). 它的光学分解和强力 激发异常 使它非常适合 生物组织内的成像,
但重建的质量仍然取决于适当的收集PSF。 因此,RIM允许我们测试本地2D PSF估计数是否有所改善
在厚厚的标本内进行横向重建.

blocks.en:
For each spatial region, we applied DeepBlur to the averaged speckle acquisitions to estimate the local collection PSF.
We then supplied the local collection PSF to AlgoRIM and compared reconstructions of the same acquisitions using either the theoretical collection
PSF or the local PSFs estimated by DeepBlur.

然后我们把本地收藏品PSF 提供给AlgoRIM 并用理论收藏品来比较 同样的收购的重建
PSF或由DeepBlur估计的当地PSF.

blocks.en:
We examined desmoplakin-immunolabelled mouse intestinal epithelium using 2D-RIM with a pupil-plane phase mask
(Fig. 5 ). The specimen was also used in the study of Mazzella et al. [ 28 ] .
Desmoplakin forms paired plaques on opposing sides of desmosomal junctions. Reported mean plaque-to-plaque distances between its C-terminal domains
range from approximately 120 to 220 nm depending on the isoform [ 2 ] , making these structures a relevant biological
benchmark for super-resolution imaging.
Using DeepBlur-estimated PSFs improved the separation of the paired structures: among 64 analysed regions, the number of intensity profiles
exhibiting an interpeak minimum increased from 43 (67%) with the theoretical PSF to 54 (84%) with DeepBlur-estimated PSFs.
The median dip increased from 0.01 (interquartile range, 0–0.09) to 0.08 (0.03–0.15), demonstrating improved discrimination of the two plaques in
the super-resolved reconstruction (Fig. 5 d,e).

blocks.en: DeepBlur for other downstream applications
blocks.zh: 用于其他下游应用的 DeepBlur

blocks.en:
On synthetically degraded Cellpose images, restoration using DeepBlur-estimated PSFs also improved segmentation across five tested models (Extended
Data Fig. 6 ), demonstrating how PSF estimation can help image analysis tasks.
blocks.zh:
关于被合成降解的Cellpose图像,使用DeepBlur估计的PSF进行还原,还改进了五个试验模型的分化(极限)
Data Fig. 6),演示PSF估计如何能帮助图像分析任务.

blocks.en:
We tested the pipeline on the public dataset BioSR [ 33 ] , in which each widefield image is paired with a super-resolved image of the
same cells. Restoring the widefield images with DeepBlur + RAM brought them closer to these higher-resolution references for all five tested image
groups. As expected for images acquired under identical optical conditions, the PSF estimates remained stable across the nine noise levels of the
dataset, with FWHMs ranging from 197 to 209 nm for a given field (Extended Data Fig. 7 ).

We also applied DeepBlur and RAM independently to the lateral planes of a spinning-disk confocal zebrafish stack (Extended Data
Fig. 9 ). The restored images show improved lateral definition of membrane structures within the volumetric acquisition.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en:
DeepBlur estimates local two-dimensional PSFs directly from fluorescence images of biological specimens, without relying on isolated point emitters or
dedicated calibration acquisitions.
Its performance rests on a physics-based training procedure and is validated quantitatively on experimental data: although trained entirely on
synthetic data, the estimator recovers PSFs from experimentally acquired images that agree closely with independently obtained references.
These comparisons assess the estimated PSF itself, complementing the improvements in image reconstruction
demonstrated across the experimental applications.
PSF estimation is fully automated, requiring neither user-supplied optical parameters nor prior knowledge of the noise level.
blocks.zh:
DeepBlur 估计本地二维 直接取自生物标本的荧光图像的PSF,而不依赖孤立点发射器或
专门校准购置。
其性能取决于基于物理的训练程序,并且通过实验数据进行定量验证:虽然培训完全基于
合成数据,估计器从实验获得的图像中恢复PSF,这些图像与独立获得的参考物密切相关.
这些比较评估了估计的PSF本身,补充了图像重建方面的改进
在实验应用中演示。
PSF的估算是完全自动化的,既不需要用户提供的光学参数,也不需要事先对噪音水平的了解.

blocks.en:
Image-based aberration estimation builds on earlier methods for local PSF prediction and spatially varying
deconvolution [ 35 , 36 , 32 ] , alongside approaches that learn to restore aberrated images
directly [ 15 ] .
Guo et al. demonstrate restoration of 3D volumes and report improved performance when the simulated aberrations match those of the sample. Their
workflow trains a separate model for each microscope and sample type using relatively well-resolved shallow volumes.
We instead train one PSF estimator across a broad simulated range and apply the same weights throughout our experimental datasets, allowing use when
sample-specific training data are unavailable.
A complementary route recovers detailed PSF models from fluorescent beads or isolated blinking molecules [ 25 ] .
In particular, in-situ single-molecule methods can capture sample-induced aberrations at the location of the emitters.
DeepBlur addresses a different acquisition setting: it exploits the spatial information contained in fluorescence images of biological specimens,
without requiring isolated emitters or their temporal separation. This enables PSF estimation from previously acquired images and from experiments
whose labelling and acquisition protocols were not designed for optical calibration.
blocks.zh:
基于图像的偏差估计基于当地PSF预测和空间差异的早期方法
解析[35、36、32],同时采用各种方法,学会恢复失常图像
直接 [15].
郭等演示了3D卷的还原,并报告在模拟异常与样品相匹配时性能得到改进. 他们
工作流程对每个显微镜和样本类型进行单独的模型训练,使用相对溶解的浅卷.
换句话说,我们训练一个PSF估计器,跨出一个广泛的模拟范围,并在整个实验数据集中应用相同的权重,允许在使用时使用。
没有特定样本的培训数据。
一个互补路线从荧光珠或被孤立的闪烁分子中回收了详细的PSF模型[25].
特别是,就地单分子方法可以捕捉出物所在地由样品引起的异常.
DeepBlur处理不同的获取环境:它利用生物标本荧光图像中的空间信息,
不需要隔离的发射体或它们的时间分离。 这使PSF能够从以前获得的图像和实验中作出估计
其标签和购置协议并非用于光学校准。

blocks.en:
The comparison with JMKPD [ 4 ] highlights the importance of the training procedure: retraining the same architecture transformed
inaccurate estimates into PSFs close to the experimental references.
Architecture also matters, as several other retrained models remained less accurate and our architecture provided a further improvement. These
observations support the joint design of the neural network architecture and its training distribution.
blocks.zh:
与JMKPD[4]的比较突出了培训程序的重要性:对同一结构进行再培训。
接近实验参考文献的PSF中的不准确估计.
建筑也很重要,因为其他几个再培训的模型仍然不够准确,我们的建筑有进一步改进。 这些
观测支持神经网络架构的联合设计及其培训分布.

blocks.en:
The two-dimensional PSFs estimated here are useful for correcting lateral blur in near-planar biological structures and optically sectioned images.
The tilted-cell experiment demonstrates correction of spatially varying defocus, while coupling DeepBlur to AlgoRIM shows that an image-derived PSF
can improve a separate reconstruction algorithm, including within biological tissue.
These applications illustrate the value of an explicit PSF that can be inspected and reused across computational imaging workflows.
They do not require full volumetric reconstruction, although a single 2D kernel cannot generally describe the mixing of fluorescence from multiple
depths in a thick specimen.
blocks.zh:
这里估计的二维PSF对于校正近平面生物结构和光学分层图像中的平面模糊是有用的.
倾斜细胞实验显示对空间差异分焦的校正,而将DeepBlur与AlgoRIM相接则显示由图像产生的PSF
可以改进单独的重建算法,包括生物组织内部的重建算法.
这些应用说明一个明确的PSF的价值,它可以在计算成像工作流程中进行检查和再利用。
虽然一个2D内核一般无法描述荧光从多个内核混合的情况,但它们并不需要完全的体积重建.
深度在厚厚的标本。

blocks.en:
Beyond restoration, DeepBlur could provide a simple tool for routine microscope monitoring.
Established metrology protocols use PSF measurements to assess resolution and identify changes in optical
performance [ 6 , 11 ] .
Estimating PSFs from a few images of extended specimens could offer a rapid, low-cost check for broadening, asymmetry or variation across the field,
without preparing dedicated point-source samples.
Repeated measurements of stable specimens under comparable acquisition conditions could help monitor changes after optical adjustments or over time.
This would complement quantitative calibration protocols with an accessible screening step, particularly in laboratories with limited optical expertise.
blocks.zh:
除了修复外,DeepBlur还可以为常规显微镜监测提供简单的工具.
既定的计量协议使用PSF测量来评估分辨率并识别光学的变化.
表现 [6, 11].
从一些扩展标本的图像中估算PSF,可以提供快速、低成本的检查,以便在整个领域扩大、不对称或变化,
而不准备专用点源样本。
在可比较的获取条件下反复测量稳定的标本有助于监测光学调整后或随着时间的推移而发生的变化。
这将以无障碍筛选步骤补充定量校正规程,特别是在光学专门知识有限的实验室。

blocks.en:
The same principle could support closed-loop adaptive optics, using image-derived PSFs to guide adjustments of a corrective element [ 18 ] .
A further direction is to infer a pupil representation, such as Zernike coefficients, from the estimated PSF.
With suitable treatment of ambiguities and adapted training, such a representation could support both wavefront correction and prediction of a
three-dimensional PSF by propagation in a homogeneous medium.
These extensions would require dedicated validation.
For the applications demonstrated here, the open-source implementation in DeepInverse [ 39 ] , the napari plugin and the web demonstration make
image-based PSF estimation readily accessible within existing microscopy workflows.
blocks.zh:
同样的原则可以支持闭路自适应光学,利用图像衍生的PSF来指导矫正元素的调整[18].
另一方向是从估计的PSF中推断出一个学生代表,如Zernike系数。
通过适当处理模棱两可之处和经过调整的培训,这种表述可以支持波前校正和预测
三维 以同质媒介传播PSF。
这些延长需要专门审定。
对于在此演示的应用程序, DeepInversion [39] 中的开源执行, Capari 插件和网络演示制作
基于图像的 PSF 估计在现有的显微镜工作流程中易于获取.

corresponding aberrated images, the reference PSFs are estimated. Column labels give the Zernike modes set on the mirror (2nd: secondary
aberration) and their amplitudes, in the
units of the mirror control software. PSFs in each column share the same commanded mirror setting. Their shapes show
common features across samples together with acquisition-to-acquisition variation; repeated commands do not guarantee
identical realised aberrations. The comparison motivates estimating a reference PSF separately for each acquisition. Each PSF is
normalized to its maximum; the central 41 × 41 41\times 41 pixels ( 2.7 ​ μ 2.7\,\mu m) are shown. Pixel size, 65 nm for both the images and the PSFs.

Figure 7 : Restoration gains and robustness of PSF estimation to noise on the BioSR dataset. ( a ) Restoration gains. For each low-resolution BioSR image [ 33 ] , PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS
were evaluated against its paired super-resolved reference after downsampling the reference to the input pixel grid. The plotted gain for each
metric M M is Δ ​ M = M ⁡ ( x ^ , x ref ) − M ⁡ ( y , x ref ) \Delta M=M(\hat{x},x_{\mathrm{ref}})-M(y,x_{\mathrm{ref}}) , where y y is the low-resolution input, x ^ \hat{x} is its
restoration by RAM using the PSF estimated by DeepBlur, and x ref x_{\mathrm{ref}} is the downsampled super-resolved reference. Positive gains in PSNR
and SSIM and negative gains in LPIPS indicate improvement. Results are grouped by specimen type and imaging condition: F-actin, nonlinear-SIM
F-actin, microtubules, clathrin-coated pits (CCPs) and endoplasmic reticulum (ER); All pools these groups. Each violin shows the distribution of
gains, its inner box the median and quartiles, and the dashed line no change.
LPIPS (Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity), a perceptual metric developed for natural images, is shown as a complementary measure;
median PSNR and SSIM improved in all groups. This comparison assesses restoration against a higher-resolution
reference, not the accuracy of the estimated PSF.
( b ) Robustness of the PSF estimation to noise, for one microtubule field (Cell 004) acquired at the nine BioSR noise levels.
Top, the 256 × 256 256\times 256 -pixel crop given to DeepBlur (sum of the nine raw SIM frames; the same crop at every level), with its signal-to-noise
ratio (SNR) above. Bottom, the single PSF that DeepBlur estimates from that crop, shown with a gamma correction of 1 / 1.5 1/1.5 , with its full
width at half maximum (FWHM, from a 2D Gaussian fit) below. Right, central horizontal profiles of the nine
PSFs on a linear scale (lighter, noisier).

blocks.en:
Figure 8 : Improved RIM resolution in a Drosophila egg chamber using DeepBlur-estimated PSFs. The actin-rich muscle sheath of a fixed stage-9 Drosophila egg chamber was imaged near the coverslip and at depth.
Left, depth-coloured overview and x x - z z view locating the two regions. Right, local PSFs, image details and intensity profiles.
Near the coverslip, at 6.7 ​ μ ​ m 6.7\,\mu\mathrm{m} , AlgoRIM with the theoretical PSF separates adjacent actin cables.
At 102.3 ​ μ ​ m 102.3\,\mu\mathrm{m} , the theoretical PSF is compared with local PSFs estimated by DeepBlur from the same acquisitions.
The broader, asymmetric estimated PSFs improve cable separation, revealing an organisation resembling that near the coverslip.
The near and far sides provide an internal structural comparison, not paired ground-truth images.
Normalized profiles along the coloured lines compare AlgoRIM (orange) and DeepBlur + AlgoRIM (blue).
Near the coverslip, two cables 0.28 μ \mu m apart are separated by a 0.18 dip. At depth, AlgoRIM with the theoretical PSF
gives a single peak or a flat top, whereas DeepBlur + AlgoRIM separates components 0.32 and 0.28 μ \mu m apart,
with dips of 0.47 and 0.22, respectively.

左,深色概览和xx-z z视图定位两个区域. 对,本地PSF,图像细节和强度剖面.
在被子的附近,在 6.7 μ m 6.7\,\ mu\ mathrm{ m},与理论 PSF 的 AlgoRIM 分离相邻的活性电缆.
在102.3 μ m 102.3\,\ mu\ mathrm{ m} 上,理论 PSF 与 DeepBlur 从同一收购中估计的本地 PSF 比较.
广义的不对称估计的PSF改善了电缆分离,揭示出一个类似被子被子附近的组织.
相近和相去甚远的两侧提供了内部结构的比较,而不是对地-真实图像进行配对.
沿有色线的常态剖面可比较AlgoRIM(橙色)和DeepBlur + AlgoRIM(蓝色).
相隔0.28 μ \ mu m的两条电缆被0. 18 个相隔。 在深度, AlgoRIM 与理论 PSF
给出一峰或一平顶,而DeepBlur + AlgoRIM 将组件相隔0.32和0.28 μ \ m,
